excerpts.author: bridge-bot
excerpts.content:
<nero_eth> I've just published the block-warming proposal + analysis:
https://ethresear.ch/t/block-level-warming/21452

The tldr is:
* block-level is "easy"
* multi-block is much more complex
* no refunds makes it less complex and, in the long run we might end up at the same.

excerpts.content: <jochembrouwer> Hey all, listening to the call, wanted to join yesterday but messed up my agenda. Super interesting! Regarding backwards compatibility in context of gas pricing, would an initial idea be (1) track down contracts which have hardcoded gas and (2) figure out how "popular" these are? Solidity by default will `GAS CALL` and thus "just" put current available gas on stack, and programmers have to explicitly set a gas param on the call to override this (I am not sure how much this is used in practice)
